title: Actions related to transmission of FailureInformation message

entities.name: Failure Information Transmission Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to transmit failure information to the network, including RLC bearer failures and DAPS failures.

entities.name: FailureInformation message
entities.description: RRC message used to report failure information to the network.

entities.name: FailureInfoRLC-Bearer
entities.description: Information element containing RLC bearer failure details including logical channel identity, cell group ID, and failure type.

entities.name: FailureInfoDAPS
entities.description: Information element containing DAPS failure information with failure type set to daps-failure.

entities.name: RLC failure information initiated
entities.description: Condition when UE is initiated to provide RLC failure information.

entities.name: DAPS failure information initiated
entities.description: Condition when UE is initiated to provide DAPS failure information.

entities.name: MCG RLC bearer failure or DAPS failure
entities.description: Condition when UE informs network about failure for MCG RLC bearer or DAPS failure information.

entities.name: SCG RLC bearer failure
entities.description: Condition when UE informs network about failure for SCG RLC bearer.

entities.name: UE in (NG)EN-DC
entities.description: Condition when UE is operating in (NG)EN-DC dual connectivity mode.

entities.name: UE in NR-DC
entities.description: Condition when UE is operating in NR-DC dual connectivity mode.

entities.name: Transmit via SRB1
entities.description: Property specifying transmission of FailureInformation message via Signaling Radio Bearer 1.

entities.name: Transmit via SRB3
entities.description: Property specifying transmission of FailureInformation message via Signaling Radio Bearer 3.

relations.description: The procedure involves transmission of the FailureInformation message.
FailureInformation message contains FailureInfoRLC-Bearer IE when RLC failure is reported.
FailureInformation message contains FailureInfoDAPS IE when DAPS failure is reported.
Condition guards the inclusion of FailureInfoRLC-Bearer IE in the message.
Condition guards the inclusion of FailureInfoDAPS IE in the message.
Condition establishes that the message should be transmitted via SRB1.
Condition establishes that the message should be transmitted via SRB3.
Condition guards the transmission method when UE is in (NG)EN-DC mode.
Condition guards the transmission method when UE is in NR-DC mode.
